sentences.text: 她长着一头乱蓬蓬，脏兮兮，长达腰际的金黄色头发，眉毛颜色非常浅，两只眼睛向外凸出，这使她老有一种吃惊的表情。
sentences.translation: She has a messy, dirty, waist-length golden hair, very light-colored eyebrows, and eyes that bulge outward, giving her a perpetually surprised expression.

sentences.text: 哈利立刻明白为什么纳威情愿放过这间包厢了。
sentences.translation: Harry immediately understood why Navie was willing to let go of this compartment.
